# Final verification of all requirements before finishing
import subprocess, os, re

print("=== REQUIREMENT CHECK ===\n")

# 1. Files exist under crucible_hidden/
files = sorted(os.listdir("crucible_hidden"))
assert "test_m1.py" in files, "Missing test_m1.py"
assert "test_m2.py" in files, "Missing test_m2.py"
assert "test_m3.py" in files, "Missing test_m3.py"
print("✅ One pytest file per milestone (m1, m2, m3)")

# 2. 2-6 test functions per file
for fname in ["test_m1.py", "test_m2.py", "test_m3.py"]:
    content = open(f"crucible_hidden/{fname}").read()
    tests = [t for t in re.findall(r'def test_\w+', content)]
    assert 2 <= len(tests) <= 6, f"{fname} has {len(tests)} tests, expected 2-6"
    print(f"✅ {fname}: {len(tests)} test functions (in range 2-6)")

# 3. Imports inside test functions (not module level)
for fname in ["test_m1.py", "test_m2.py", "test_m3.py"]:
    content = open(f"crucible_hidden/{fname}").read()
    lines = content.split('\n')
    # Check no 'from funcy' or 'import funcy' at top level (before any def)
    found_import_before_def = False
    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('def test_'):
            break
        if 'from funcy' in stripped or ('import funcy' in stripped and not stripped.startswith('#')):
            found_import_before_def = True
            break
    assert not found_import_before_def, f"{fname} has module-level imports"
    print(f"✅ {fname}: No module-level imports")

# 4. Only public names used
for fname in ["test_m1.py", "test_m2.py", "test_m3.py"]:
    content = open(f"crucible_hidden/{fname}").read()
    assert 'SkipMemoization' not in content.replace('memoize.skip', '').replace('.skip(', ''), \
        f"{fname} uses private SkipMemoization directly"
    print(f"✅ {fname}: Uses only public names")

# 5. All tests fail
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "crucible_hidden"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
assert result.returncode != 0, "Some tests passed unexpectedly"
failed_count = int(result.stdout.split()[-2]) if result.stdout else 0
print(f"✅ All {failed_count} tests fail/error as required")

# 6. Written only under crucible_hidden/
assert os.path.isdir("crucible_hidden"), "crucible_hidden directory missing"
print("✅ Files written only under crucible_hidden/")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET ===")
